title: C_CreateObject for data objects not supported
description:
wolfP11 does not implement C_CreateObject for CKO_DATA (data objects). pkcs11test's DataObjectTest.* tests create data objects, find them, query attributes, and destroy them.

Impact (7 pkcs11test failures):
- DataObjectTest.CopyDestroyObjectInvalid
- DataObjectTest.FindNoObject
- DataObjectTest.FindObject
- DataObjectTest.FindObjectInvalid
- DataObjectTest.GetMultipleAttributes
- DataObjectTest.GetMultipleAttributesInvalid
- DataObjectTest.GetSetAttributeInvalid

SoftHSM2 reference: SoftHSM2 passes all DataObjectTest.* tests.

Implementation note: DataObjectTest uses read-write sessions and C_CreateObject(CKO_DATA,...) to create in-memory data objects. These do not need to be stored in the keystore for session objects (CKA_TOKEN=false). wolfP11's object storage can be extended to support CKO_DATA session objects.
